launches.title: Gravy - Agents for your personal finances
launches.tagline: Connect to your banks, investments, email and more to explain your money and automate your financial tasks.
launches.body:
Meet [**Gravy**](https://gravy.finance)! The AI agent that automates your personal finances for you - optimising your spending, finding savings, and handling the tedious money tasks you never get around to.

Try it at [**gravy.finance**](http://gravy.finance)

In 5 years, the way everyone manages their money will look radically different. Gravy is an AI agent that doesn't just track your finances, but acts on them. Connect up, and Gravy works for you in the background as your finances update day to day. 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=102394&key=user_uploads/1178479/43c3c08c-3595-46a6-8813-aad8cb00f8c9)

Your money is deeply personal, and so is Gravy. **It’s totally customisable** and your **data stays local on your Mac**. Here are some things it can do:

* “Track my angel investments by syncing my Gmail to my portfolio.”
* "I uploaded my rental contract. Track rent, deposits, and bills, and move xxxx every month from my Barclays to my HSBC to cover it, and negotiate better deals on utilities where you can."
* “What recurring subscriptions do I have? Go cancel xxxx. Any other fees I could be avoiding?”
* “Use your dedicated agent card to organise date night’’
* “Create a custom page to track all my credit cards; spending, smarter debt payoff, and am I using my Wells Fargo points efficiently?"

We're repeat co-founders with deep consumer experience.\
Ali previously cofounded **KiranaKart,** which later became the Indian unicorn **Zepto**, and worked in iShares at BlackRock.\
Max was an AI Engineer at a consumer business with over 12 million active users.

[Give it a free try here](https://gravy.finance), and let us know what you think.
